question.problem:
Consider the the bilinear form $B(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}),$ given by 

$$
B(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})= 2 x_1y_2 - x_2y_2 +3 x_2y_3-x_3y_1
$$

 

Evaluate $B(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})$ when ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14124253/assets/e355ba8664f980f8e06bcbda40adf063d376478e745b9b6b036331a895192c54.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14124253/assets/7fe125bd6366adb85e10ab5719049e1e0db7c719b4a714f9155efee77a8f604b.svg)
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\qquad$ ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14124253/assets/14418dfa570c1be7015799f009ad93388a6dd6d04bed48972bc8163351bbeb87.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14124253/assets/8bc4748c7c554dc1edfbdce567f9e6d994ebe0955346bfa34712e20286aaa3b3.svg) 

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{3}-{x}_{3}{y}_{1} \\  & =2\cdot 1\cdot 2-1\cdot 2+3\cdot 1\cdot 1-(-1)\cdot (-2) \\  & =4-2+3-2 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
